publication_notes: Copy selected original bytes if publishing; retain these SHA256 values. No crop, regeneration, recoloring or annotation was applied.
Use full-window images for editor/control-panel claims and viewport PNG for scene clarity.
The transition image was captured while the endpoint run was active; its caption grants no completion or safety result.
Do not infer strict smoothness, monitor scanout, input latency, sensed control or learned behavior from still images.
